name: Final Passage
summary: Parqual Fintallas tells you that you have passed this test and the ones before it. You are sent back to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles, who will sense the change in you and see whether you have grown strong in mind, body and spirit, enough to be honoured for your efforts.

sections.title: Back to the Weathered Nook
sections.body: This is the last step of the Test of Faith, the chain of trials that Dorn Plainstalker began. Dorn waits in the Weathered Nook, in a cave reached by a ramp, north of Freewind Post. Parqual Fintallas urges you to stay true to the balance you have shown throughout these trials.

sections.title: Dorn's Welcome
sections.body: Dorn remarks that you have been away from his home for a long while, and many moons since your first leap set you on this path. He finds you stronger and more enlightened than before, which pleases him, and says you deserve to be honoured for seeing his tests through to the end.

faq.q: Who sends you on this final step?
faq.answer: Parqual Fintallas, who tells you that you have passed his test and the tests before his.
Back to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles. He waits in the Weathered Nook, in a cave reached by a ramp, north of Freewind Post.
It follows Test of Lore, an earlier trial in the same chain.

faq.q: What was the very first step of this journey?
faq.answer: Test of Faith, given by Dorn Plainstalker in the Weathered Nook. This is the final step of that chain.

faq.q: Why does Parqual send you back to Dorn?
faq.answer: Parqual says Dorn will notice the change in you and find your mind, body and spirit strong enough to deserve honour.

angles.text: This chain of trials is set for the Horde, and it ends with Dorn Plainstalker.
